label: There is a relation R under which every being is R-accessible, yet below one being there are…
meaning: An axiom-free fidelity check on the Second Way premise's formalization: accessibility (well-foundedness) is not finite or bounded depth. A being with infinitely many immediate causes can be accessible although its descending chains have every finite length. Glossing DEF-REGRESS-ACCESSIBILITY-READING as a finite-depth certificate would strengthen it. Leaves STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-SERIES open.
